# convoy_endpoint (Data Source)

Look up an endpoint by `id` or by exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "convoy_endpoint" "legacy" {
  name = "legacy-receiver"
}

resource "convoy_subscription" "legacy_all" {
  name        = "legacy-all-events"
  endpoint_id = data.convoy_endpoint.legacy.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Endpoint ID.
- `name` (String) Exact endpoint name. Must match exactly one endpoint.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Active signing secret.
- `status` (String) `active`, `inactive` or `paused`.
- `url` (String) Endpoint URL.
